Topic: Ensure text remains readable when users adjust spacing
Do: Allow user-controlled text spacing without loss of content or functionality
Support line-height of at least 1.5 when user sets it
Support paragraph spacing of at least 2x default line-height
Support letter spacing of at least 0.12em
Support word spacing of at least 0.16em
Use relative units (em, rem) for spacing and sizing
Avoid fixed height containers that clip text when spacing increases
Allow text to reflow and wrap naturally
Ensure no overlapping of adjacent text blocks at larger spacing
Test text spacing at various zoom levels (up to 200%)
Avoid white-space: nowrap on blocks that need to reflow
Ensure buttons and controls expand to accommodate spaced text
Ensure tables can reflow or scroll horizontally without clipping text
Provide adequate space in input fields for increased letter spacing
Ensure labels remain associated with inputs after spacing changes
Avoid absolute positioning that can prevent reflow
Ensure headings and lists remain readable with increased spacing
Use flexible layout containers (flexbox, grid) that allow reflow
Check that icons and text remain aligned with increased spacing
Ensure placeholder text also scales and reflows with spacing
Ensure media captions reflow correctly with spacing changes
Avoid using images of text that cannot reflow
Test forms with increased spacing to ensure usability
Ensure tooltips and dropdowns size to fit spaced content
Allow user stylesheets or browser extensions to override spacing
Ensure accessible focus outlines remain visible with increased spacing
Ensure text in SVG is responsive to spacing changes where possible
Avoid cropping text in responsive cards or tiles when spacing increases
Provide sufficient vertical space in lists to prevent overlap
Ensure stacked UI elements expand to accommodate spaced text
Test on small viewports to ensure no text clipping occurs
Ensure content inside modals reflows and is fully reachable
Confirm that line-length remains readable with expanded spacing
Ensure keyboard navigation order is unaffected by reflow
Allow user zoom and spacing adjustments to work together
Avoid CSS rules that reset user spacing preferences
Support spacing adjustments for all user-facing languages
Document text spacing expectations for content authors
Dont: Don’t use fixed pixel heights for text containers
Don’t clip or hide text when spacing is increased
Don’t prevent wrapping with white-space: nowrap where wrapping is needed
Don’t rely on images for key text content
Don’t hard-code line-height that prevents user overrides
Don’t set overflow: hidden on text that may expand
Don’t use negative margins that cause overlap when spacing increases
Don’t assume default spacing will be used by all users
Don’t truncate text with ellipses when it can reflow
Don’t position text with absolute coordinates that break on reflow
Don’t use fixed-size buttons that clip labeled text
Don’t rely on precise spacing for icon and text alignment
Don’t use custom fonts that break at larger spacing without fallback
Don’t hide form labels to save space when spacing increases
Don’t prevent user style overrides via !important rules
Don’t create responsive breakpoints that collapse content invisibly
Don’t assume language line-breaking behavior is same for all locales
Don’t put text in graphics without providing a text alternative
Don’t use JS that enforces a fixed layout preventing reflow
Don’t design tables that cannot adapt when text spacing increases
Don’t disable browser zoom that users may use with spacing changes
Don’t allow overflowing text to become unreachable off-screen
Don’t use line-clamp techniques that hide content on spacing change
Don’t rely on preformatted elements for primary content layout
Don’t place interactive controls in fixed-size containers that clip labels
Don’t rely on background images to position text content
Don’t hide overflow on containers that hold spaced text
Don’t use CSS that removes word-break opportunities needed for reflow
Don’t anchor important UI to fixed pixel offsets that break with spacing
Don’t ignore platform-specific text spacing behaviors
Edge cases: Paragraph line-height increase causes overlap with adjacent floated elements
Heading wraps into next UI element at larger letter spacing
Input placeholder clipped when letter spacing increased
Buttons resize but surrounding layout breaks with added spacing
SVG-rendered text does not respect CSS letter-spacing
Table cells overflow with increased word spacing causing horizontal scroll
Modal dialog content grows beyond viewport when spacing increased
Custom fonts cause unexpected glyph spacing at higher settings
CSS grid template areas become unusable with spaced content
Pseudo-elements positioned near text overlap after spacing change
Responsive card heights fixed causing text to be hidden with spacing
Tooltips positioned absolutely overlap other content on reflow
Accessibility overlays applying spacing conflict with site styles
News tickers or marquees break when spacing increases
Form field labels detach visually from inputs when spacing increased
Long compound words cause long unbreakable stretches that overflow
Emoji or icon fonts change alignment with larger letter spacing
Third-party widgets do not respond to spacing changes and overlap
Browser extension applying spacing causes layout shift in flex containers
Print-to-PDF rendering clips text when spacing increased
